name: building_draw
note: renders the visible floors (scroll_y/30+5 = top floor DAT_8a3c, 5 floors x 30 px) into building bitmap DAT_8eba (0xd0 x 0x96); scrolls by one floor via blit_rect when possible; day/night switch by hour_index (<4) reloads font/sprite set 00f4 (1c74_0517) and DAT_117c, building_walls_draw; draws sky, floors (0x7c62 table), elevator per floor (building_elevator_draw)

name: building_view_present
note: blit_rect building bitmap 8eba -> screen 8e62 at (0x38,4), 0xd0 x 0x6d, source row from DAT_8a3c*30-(8c2e+0x6d)

name: building_elevator_draw
note: draws elevator shaft/doors on floor into 8eba: cabin position DAT_8bba (floor) + DAT_0128 (pixel offset), door state DAT_012a; figures riding (state 3) drawn inside cabin

name: building_sides_draw
note: redraws left/right side panels (bank 00f4, 7b12, 8c36) on screen when scroll DAT_8c2e changed or DAT_7a0c/8c4a force; remembers scroll in 11a4

name: building_animate
note: per-tick building update: elevator_update, npc_update, (if room 0) building_draw(8c2e) + building_sides_draw + building_view_present, figures_update, building_hover_draw, extra overlays (7a0c, 7a42 marker); calls mouse_update between steps; skipped if DAT_012c==2

name: figures_update
note: moves and draws the 6 figures (table 0x7b22, 30 B: +0 x, +2 floor, +4 target x, +6 target floor, +0xc state, +0xe mode, +0x10 room/door, +0x18 step); draw order: walking first; big switch (broken jump table); clip 4..0x71

name: npc_update
note: for figures 0..5 (players only if not controlled/out: 8bbc+0x14+p): chooses random target floor (1..12) and door (floor_door_count/floor_door_prev), opens doors (door_draw), handles arrival states

name: elevator_update
note: elevator logic: target floor from riding figure (state 3) or request queue 8c4c (elevator_request_remove on arrival), moves cabin DAT_8bba/0128 by speed DAT_7a2e, door state 012a; updates building scroll DAT_8c2e to follow the human figure (7af2), clamped 0..0x141. Return value is garbage (void)

name: building_hover_draw
note: in building view: draws greeting sprites when figures meet, door name boxes under the mouse (door_label_text + draw_frame + text_box), message box for DAT_79ca (fmt with player name), panel tooltips via 239a_3132/31b2/31f5

name: door_label_text
note: returns newly allocated label string (fmt 1d41_0003 with player names/channel 8bbc-0x7444.., or text 1c74_0733) for door slot on floor using tables 0x7c62+floor*0x7a (+0x1e type, +0x28 text id, +0x46 owner); 0 if owner eliminated. Returns far ptr DX:AX

name: player_eliminated_sequence
note: player DAT_7a34 leaves the game: falling-figure animation along the facade (HES 0x1c,0x1d,0x18+player); human -> game over screen (HES 0x1e), savegame 3077_11be(0x2b), return to title; AI -> flags player out, frees contracts/archive/studios, removes elevator request

name: facade_draw
note: draws the scrolling building facade (bank 0104 = HES 0x1c) on screen 8e62 using scroll DAT_8c2e; used by player_eliminated_sequence
